scope: Offline typed-coordinate derivation of the frozen H04/v16 Play2Code program against retained exact H01 translation and H02 reflection references

implementation.translation: One strict integer XYZ translation is applied after any reflection.
implementation.voxel_reflection: For selected horizontal axis and integer lattice coordinate C: v' = 2*C - v.
implementation.point_reflection: Continuous feet, pose, target and hit points reflect about the matching block-centre plane C + 0.5.
implementation.yaw: Yaw is reflected with the horizontal view vector; pitch is retained.
implementation.faces: East/west or north/south support faces are exchanged for the selected reflection axis.
implementation.recorded_controls: Mirroring exchanges left/right, forward-left/forward-right and back-left/back-right while retaining forward/back/hold.
typed_operations: M0 movement point, recorded yaw and direction
M3 recorded path points, yaw and direction codes
M4 recorded movement/placement points, yaw, direction codes, support voxels, faces, poses and hit points
M5 edge/landing points, yaw and direction
I3 support voxels, faces, recorded pose and recorded aim
implementation.s1_semantics: The recorded point and voxel homes remain unchanged. Exactly one first-batch S1 relative is retained; continuation batches do not re-home.

retained_first_attempt.reason: M4 recorded_path_diverged at sample 5 because reflected yaw retained recorded right rather than exchanging it for left.

decisions.mirroring_native_replay: GO via X03; X02 remains NO_GO

boundaries: The derived exports are not new human recordings and do not replace H01, H02 or H04 verdicts.
The qualification covers the frozen H04 construction strategy and two exact retained Superflat reference geometries only.
It does not establish arbitrary structures, unequal terrain, other dimensions, broad modpack portability or a different human strategy.
Independent native and closed-save verification, not compilation or action receipts, establishes each replay objective.
privacy: Raw timelines, absolute captured homes, player identity, actor tokens, worlds, journals, credentials, certificates and private keys remain outside this public-safe evidence file.
